messages:
elaine: heading out for a sunset drive later, need a ~90min mixtape + a tiny film (<=30m) to watch during a coffee/gas stop. suggest 3 tracks + 1 short film please :)
tomas: ok 3 from me: 'The Stable Song - Gregory Alan Isakov', 'Stubborn Love (acoustic) - The Lumineers', 'Old Pine - Ben Howard' / short: 'World of Tomorrow' (11m) — weird and lovely.
ravi: adding 'Heartbeats - José González', 'Roslyn - Bon Iver & St. Vincent', 'Cherry - Rina Sawayama (acoustic version)' / short film rec: 'The Black Hole' (animated, like 7m) :thinking_face:
zoe: 'To Build a Home - The Cinematic Orchestra', 'Sea of Love - Cat Power', 'No Such Thing - John Mayer (acoustic)' / short: 'Stutterer' (13m) — romantic, hits the feels.
nora: shoutout for a b-side: 'King and Cross - Ásgeir' and 'Riverside - Agnes Obel' and 'Holocene (live) - Bon Iver' / short film: 'The Silent Child' (20m) — heavy but excellent. :thumbsup:
yt-bot: YouTube Short added: https://youtu.be/exampleShortLinkWorldOfTomorrow (World of Tomorrow - Don Hertzfeldt)
spotify-bot: Collaborative playlist created: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/exampleMixtape90 (~92m) — invite: anyone can add.
tomas: also low-effort meme idea: someone gifs a cat at the wheel when we hit the motorway :joy:
elaine: love the cat gif idea. one quick poll: prefer vibe A) slow, cinematic & instrumental or B) singer-songwriter + quiet vocals? react :a: or :b:
zoe: :a: (instrumental moody drives always)
ravi: :b: (singalong in the car!!)
nora: :a:
tomas: :b: but instrumentals for the sunset portion.
elaine: poll leaning B but ill blend. if you add tracks, plz include live or acoustic tags. dropping playlist in 30. thanks team :heart:
